title: Breadth-First Search
description: Given an adjacency list graph and a start node, return the BFS traversal order.

title: Depth-First Search
description: Given an adjacency list graph and a start node, return the DFS traversal order.
solution:
def dfs(graph, start):
    visited = set()
    order = []
    def traverse(node):
        if node in visited: return
        visited.add(node)
        order.append(node)
        for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
            traverse(neighbor)
    traverse(start)
    return order
